title: PSD district environment file
description: Schema for the private <district-id>.env.yml referenced by psd-dev-standards standards/08-iac.md 'Private environment file'. The real file never lives in a public repo; schemas/iac/example.env.yml is a placeholder instance. Resolved via PSD_ENV_FILE and validated by .github/workflows/reusable-env-file-check.yml in PSD401/.github before any Terraform/Packer job reads it.

district_id.description: Short district code used as a prefix in resource names (e.g. state-bucket and deploy-role names). Real values are lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens; example.env.yml uses the <token> placeholder instead (08-iac.md 'Private environment file').

network.description: On-prem network facts consumed by the Proxmox and on-prem templates.

vlans.description: One VLAN entry per network tier. Each entry's id is the numeric VLAN ID; subnet is its CIDR block.

internal_root.description: Name or path of the internal root CA used to trust on-prem TLS endpoints.

syslog_target.description: Central syslog endpoint, as host:port or a URL.

ntp_servers.description: NTP server list. Placeholder until the ops process defines a standard set (08-iac.md 'Private environment file').

timezone.description: IANA timezone name. Placeholder until the ops process defines it.

patch_window.description: Free-text patch/maintenance window. Placeholder until the ops process defines it.

resource_pools.description: Map of repo name to its Proxmox resource pool name. One entry per repo that provisions on-prem VMs.

vmid_ranges.description: Map of purpose to its reserved VMID range, e.g. "templates: 9000-9099" (15-onprem-platform.md rule 14). Each value is a strict "<start>-<end>" pair so the conftest VMID-range check can parse it; record any reuse caveat in vmid_reuse_notes instead, never appended here.

vmid_reuse_notes.description: Optional free-text record of VMID reassignment after deletion (15-onprem-platform.md rule 17), e.g. which purpose's range has had IDs reused and why. Not parsed by any conftest check; keep range math out of vmid_ranges values.

bridge_availability.description: Per-node bridge/VLAN uplink registry (15-onprem-platform.md §4 rule 16): maps each Proxmox node name to the bridge or VLAN names uplinked on it. A VM needing a bridge absent from a node's list must be pinned to a node where that bridge is present, and a comment recorded next to the resource. Optional until a conftest rule reads it (named gap, 15-onprem-platform.md §4 rule 16, §13).

state_bucket_prefix.description: Root of the Terraform state-bucket naming pattern, e.g. "example-tfstate" (full name is <prefix>-<account-alias>-<region>, 08-iac.md 'Platform: AWS (Terraform)').

account_alias.description: Account alias per environment tier, used in resource-naming patterns.

region_default.description: Default AWS region for this district's workloads.

region_ai.description: AWS region used for Bedrock-heavy workloads (13-aws-accounts.md rule 6 allows us-east-1 for this).

alerts_topic_name.description: Name of the SNS topic every CloudWatch alarm action targets, present in each workload account (08-iac.md, district defaults). Apps look it up by name and never create their own.

bedrock_default_model_id.description: Bedrock model ID an app uses when the task names none (08-iac.md, district defaults). Apps take it as a variable with no default.

student_pii.description: Account-level controls for AWS accounts that hold student-pii roots (08-iac.md#student-pii-account-posture), read by the account-baseline root and, reduced by scripts/iac/resolve_env_file.py --student-pii-out, by the account_controls and unmask conftest rules. Optional: a district with no student-pii workload on AWS omits it.

regions.description: AWS regions that carry student-pii roots. The account baseline puts a data protection policy in each.

guardrail_mode.description: "organization" when the district has an AWS Organization and attaches the baseline's SCPs; "standalone" for an account outside an Organization, where no SCP applies.

breakglass_role_name.description: IAM role name of the break-glass role, the only principal allowed to unmask student-pii log data. The account-baseline apply-role boundary and the SCP name it. The app deploy-role boundary has no carve-out for it.

breakglass_permission_set_name.description: IAM Identity Center permission set whose role may assume the break-glass role. The trust matches its AWSReservedSSO_<name>_ role in this account. The identity source enforces MFA at sign-in, because federated sessions carry no aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent key.

managed_identifiers.description: AWS managed data identifier ARNs the account data protection policy audits and masks. Omit to use the default three.

custom_identifiers.description: District-specific data identifiers, such as the student-number shape. CloudWatch Logs allows at most 10 per policy.

regex.description: Identifier regex, at most 200 characters from the CloudWatch Logs set: letters, digits, space and _ # = @ / ; , - ^ $ ? [ ] { } | \ * + . (no parentheses, colons, quotes or newlines). The pattern ends in (?![\s\S]) rather than $ so a trailing newline from a YAML block scalar fails.

test_matches.description: Strings the regex must match. Use fabricated values, never a real student's.

test_non_matches.description: Strings the regex must not match.

ses.description: SES sending controls (17-email-sending.md rules 3 and 9). approved_from_addresses, reduced by scripts/iac/resolve_env_file.py --ses-out, is the list the ses_send conftest rule compares each IAM ses:FromAddress pin against. Optional: a district with no app sending through SES omits it, and a plan that pins ses:FromAddress is then denied.

approved_from_addresses.description: From addresses an app may send as: app mail groups and their aliases. Compared case-insensitively. No * or ? wildcards, since the rule compares pins to entries as literals.

state_backend.description: Terraform state backend for GCP. GCS is the standard; "s3" exists only for a district that deliberately centralizes state in AWS.

deploy_role_prefix.description: Root of the OIDC deploy-role naming pattern, e.g. "example-deploy" (full name is <prefix>-<repo>-<env>, 08-iac.md 'Deploy roles and OIDC').

change_request_system.description: Placeholder until the ops process defines how change requests are tracked.

pbs_backup_schedule.description: Proxmox Backup Server job schedule for the hypervisor-level image backup, in PBS's own schedule syntax (a calendar event string such as "daily", or a cron expression). This is the disaster-recovery floor layer; an app's own backup runbook covers application-level restore separately (15-onprem-platform.md §10 rule 39).

iac_owner_role.description: Role title only, never a person's name. Schema validation checks type, not whether the value is actually a role (08-iac.md 'Private environment file', a named gap).

id.description: Numeric VLAN ID (1-4094). example.env.yml uses the <token> placeholder instead of a real integer (08-iac.md 'Private environment file'), so this accepts either.

subnet.description: CIDR block for this VLAN, e.g. "10.0.0.0/24".

allowed_data_classifications.description: Data classifications permitted to run on this VLAN, using the same enum as the psd:data-classification tag (08-iac.md District defaults). Maps the VLAN's infrastructure role to the data sensitivity it's approved to carry (15-onprem-platform.md §4 rule 16). Until cluster.fw is enabled (§5 rules 19-21), this is a declared policy, not an enforced control.
